scenes.audio: After catching it, it can even walk and hand it to a person.
scenes.label: Opening Hook
scenes.visual: A static camera capture of a laboratory setting with whiteboards, desks, and robotic equipment. In the center, a bipedal robot with a metallic grey frame and a white box-like head catches a brown cardboard box thrown by a person. The person is an East Asian male, approximately 20-30 years old, wearing a black long-sleeve shirt, black pants, and white sneakers. The lighting is bright, even, and artificial (cool-toned fluorescent). The background shows various cables, a rolling chair, and server racks.

scenes.audio: The second one is even more impressive, called SGS.
scenes.label: Product Information
scenes.visual: Static close-up shot focusing on a three-pronged metallic robotic claw. The claw descends toward a white flat surface where a small grey cylindrical object is lying. The lighting is bright and white, creating a clinical, clean environment. The color palette is dominated by whites and metallic greys.

scenes.audio: It was trained entirely in simulation.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: A digital simulation environment showing a white robotic arm mounted on a frame. The arm is performing precise movements over a square plate. The environment is minimalist and virtual with soft shadows. The camera is static, viewing the arm from a slightly elevated side angle.

scenes.audio: Not a single real-world demonstration was given.
scenes.label: Product Selling Points
scenes.visual: The same digital simulation as the previous scene, but a large graphic overlay appears in the center of the frame featuring a large zero. The robotic arm continues its motion in the background, which is slightly darkened to emphasize the central graphic.

scenes.audio: And then it directly goes onto a real robotic arm to tighten nuts and assemble gears.
scenes.label: Usage Scenarios
scenes.visual: A split-screen comparison showing two real-world robotic arms. On the left, a silver robotic arm with black joints is shown from the side, interacting with a blue platform. On the right, a close-up of a similar robotic hand is shown assembling a white gear onto a pin. The lighting is natural lab lighting with a warmish tint. The camera for both views is static.

scenes.audio: Its training method is actually very easy to understand, just like a fitness coach leading you.
scenes.label: Problem Solving
scenes.visual: The split-screen continues. On the left, the robotic hand picks up a small black component and places it into a hole on the blue base. On the right, the hand successfully pushes the white plastic gear down onto its axle. The movements are smooth and robotic. The background shows blurred lab equipment and red power cables.
